_comment: Proposals an agent might make. Each names the outcome the policy must reach and why, so the fixture file doubles as a readable statement of the redlines.

cases.name: snapshot deletion in production
cases.because: a snapshot is a point in time and cannot be recreated; the proposal's own REVERSIBLE claim is overridden by the action class

cases.name: reversibility could not be established
cases.because: not knowing whether it can be undone is not evidence that it can

cases.name: over-broad production change
cases.because: 40 resources exceeds the production ceiling of 5, even though each restart is individually reversible

cases.name: compensable production delete, unapproved
cases.because: a final backup restores the data but the restored volume has a new id, so every mount referencing the old one breaks

cases.name: compensable production delete, approved
cases.because: a human accepted the identity loss; the approval came from context, not from the proposal

cases.name: agent asserts its own approval
cases.because: the proposal's self-asserted approval is ignored; authority is read from context only

cases.name: blast radius not supplied
cases.because: the ceiling cannot be applied to an unknown count

cases.name: unknown environment gets the strictest ceiling
cases.because: a typo in the environment name must not buy the loosest ceiling

cases.name: outside the declared change window
cases.because: timing is a human call, and the window state comes from context
